redeem.partialHint: Only part of your credit can be redeemed now. The rest becomes available as borrowers repay or are liquidated.
redeem.exceeds: Amount exceeds what can be redeemed now

exit.borrowTitle: Close your loan on the market
exit.lendDescription: Sell credit to borrowers in the order book instead of waiting for maturity.
exit.borrowDescription: Buy your debt back from lenders in the order book and take out the collateral it frees, in one transaction — or only withdraw collateral. The more debt you buy back, the more collateral can leave. Before maturity buying back usually costs less than repaying at par.
exit.rateHelp: Limits the price you accept. Defaults to the quote ± 0.5 points.
exit.smallAmountsNote: Early exits take offers from the order book: try a small amount first.
exit.payInputAria: Amount of {symbol} to pay to buy your debt back
exit.debtHint: Debt {debt} · buying all of it back now costs {cost}
exit.debtHintThinBook: Debt {debt} · the order book is too thin to buy all of it back now: at most {amount} can be spent. A limit order waits for sellers at your price.

limit.borrowDescription: Offer to buy your debt back at your own price. The order rests in the book until a borrower takes it or the market matures, and you can cancel it at any time. Unlike a market exit, it needs nobody selling right now.
limit.lendDescription: Offer to sell your credit at your own price. The order rests in the book until a lender takes it or the market matures, and you can cancel it at any time. Unlike a market exit, it needs nobody buying right now.
limit.fundsNote: The {symbol} stays in your wallet until the order fills, and it has to be there then: each fill pulls it at your price. The order is skipped while the wallet cannot pay.
limit.priceHelpBuy: Per unit of debt, 1 being repayment at par. You never pay more. {apy} APY at this price.
limit.priceHelpSell: Per unit of credit, 1 being the face value. You never receive less. {apy} APY at this price.
limit.priceInvalid: Enter a price above 0 and at most 1.
limit.payInputAria: Amount of {symbol} to pay for your debt at the limit price
limit.receiveInputAria: Amount of {symbol} to receive for your credit at the limit price
limit.debtHint: Debt {position} · all of it costs {value} at this price{hasOpen, select, yes { · {open} already in open exit orders} other {}}
limit.creditHint: Credit {position} · all of it brings {value} at this price{hasOpen, select, yes { · {open} already in open exit orders} other {}}
limit.unsupported: Limit orders are not available on this network.
limit.nearMaturity: This market is too close to maturity for a limit order. Exit at the market price instead.
limit.entryConflictBorrow: To post an exit order, cancel your open borrow orders in this market first.
limit.entryConflictLend: To post an exit order, cancel your open lend orders in this market first.
limit.allInOrders: All of your position is already offered in open exit orders.
limit.exceedsSpendable: Not enough {symbol} for this order: the wallet holds {balance} and your open buy orders already count on {reserved}.
limit.crossesBuy: Your price reaches the cheapest borrow order in the book: a market exit fills this now at a better price.
limit.crossesSell: Your price reaches the best lend order in the book: a market exit fills this now at a better price.
limit.belowMinimum: The order book takes limit orders from {min}. Raise the amount.
limit.positionBelowMinimum: What is left to exit ({max}) is below the {min} minimum for a limit order: repay it at par or exit at the market price.
limit.notRatified: The order was not approved yet. Try again.
limit.success: Limit order placed. It shows in your open orders once the API indexes it.
